fact: The GPE Teacher Support Programme document approved on 10 March 2025 budgets TZS 1,068,490,000 (US$458,186) of GPE grant money for a school quality assurance module inside the existing School Information System (SIS), and says the initial activities were supported by FCDO under Shule Bora.
title: Programme Document: Teacher Support Programme (TSP), Revised to Integrate 2024 Additional Financing (AdF) from the Compact Triggers (Top Up) and Multiplier Grant (MG)
publisher: United Republic of Tanzania, Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST)
